units: Nidd. 38ᵃ ש׳ דירחא Ar. (ed. only ש׳) the shofar announcing the New Moon.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 27b:13">M. Kat. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>שמע קל ש׳ דשכבא</he> he heard the trumpet announcing a death in town; a. e.—Pl. <he>שִׁיפוֹרֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 40a:6">Ab. Zar. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>נפקי ש׳ דרבא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>נפק</he>) the announcements of Raba went forth to prohibit it, and those of R. H. permitting it; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 57b:8">ib. 57ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 17b:1">M. Kat. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>קרי ביה אלפא ש׳ וכ׳</he> sound into it (the pitcher) one thousand blasts (proclaiming the ban).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 17b:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מאי שיפ̇ור̇י שנפ̇ר̇עין וכ׳</he> what does the blowing signify? That he will be punished.

<cite ref="Shevuot 36a:4">Shebu. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>בארבע מאה ש׳ שמתיה וכ׳</he> Barak declared the ban over Meroz with four hundred blasts of the trumpet; <cite ref="Moed Katan 16a:8">M. Kat. 16ᵃ</cite>; a. e.
Gitt. 60ᵇ ההוא ש׳ דהוה the charity box which was first kept in the house of R. J., and was transferred to &c.; [otb. opin. the shofar for public announcements].
